stacks.finding: Treatment is with azithromycin or a fluoroquinolone (such as ciprofloxacin). Fluoroquinolones have historically been first-line, empiric options for treatment of traveler's diarrhea, but azithromycin is now being used more often given the increasing rates of fluoroquinolone resistance and adverse side effects of fluoroquinolone therapy. Rifaximin and rifamycin (rifamycin is not currently available on the USMLE test yet) are also acceptable alternatives.
